crossRefs.note: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…
Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of…
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show…

translations.web: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
translations.bsb: I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”
translations.kjv: For I suppose I was ➔ not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
translations.asv: For I reckon that I am not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
